title: Cacti Slow-Release Plant Food
description:
How to Use and Dosage

  • Existing Pots: Sprinkle 1 scoop (10ml) on top of the soil in Ø22cm pots and water as usual.
  • Repotting: Repot your plant as normal. 180 days after repotting mix 1 scoop (10ml) into 5L of substrate and mix it through the soil.

Tips

  • Fertilize only while the plant is growing (spring/summer). Pause during fall and winter.
  • Less is more: Never exceed the recommended dosage.
  • No need to dissolve in water—apply directly to the soil.
  • Do not use this fertiliser the first 180 days after repotting with SYBASoil!

Cacti Slow-Release Plant Food

Cacti Slow-Release Plant Food is the simple way to keep desert plants nourished over time without constant feeding. This cactus slow release fertilizer is designed for low-maintenance care, giving your plants a steady supply of nutrients for months with just one application. Especially effective in mineral substrates like SYBAStones Cacti Mineral Mix, these cactus nutrient pellets provide clean, measured support for resilient, compact growth.

Why Slow-Release Care Suits Cacti

Cacti are adapted to thrive in nutrient-poor environments, which means they need less food than leafy houseplants but still benefit from the right balance. A standard fertilizer can overwhelm roots with too much nitrogen, leading to weak or stretched growth. Cactus controlled release fertilizer avoids this by focusing on low-nitrogen, potassium-rich nutrition that strengthens root systems, supports firm tissues, and helps your plants stay healthy through the growing season.

How It Works in Mineral Mixes

In non-organic setups such as SYBAStones, nutrients can quickly wash away without a controlled feeding source. Cactus fertilizer granules gradually release cactus nutrients into the substrate, ensuring long term stability. This method reduces the need for frequent fertilizing while protecting sensitive roots from sudden overload. With cactus care pellets, your plants receive consistent feeding that suits their slow and steady rhythm.

Benefits of Cactus Growth Pellets

  • Provides measured nutrition ideal for desert-adapted plants
  • Supplies potassium-rich support for strong roots and firm growth
  • Works seamlessly in SYBAStones Cacti Mineral Mix for balanced release
  • Prevents weak, leggy growth by avoiding nitrogen-heavy spikes
  • Offers long term fertilizer benefits with minimal upkeep
  • Season-adjusting; Automatically feeds more in summer, less in winter

With cactus release nutrition, your plants remain compact, resilient, and true to their natural form.

Eco-Conscious and Grower Approved

Sybotanica develops every SYBASupport formula with sustainability and effectiveness in mind. This cactus long term fertilizer is made with clean, safe ingredients and designed to meet the needs of real growers. Trusted by cactus enthusiasts across Europe, it offers a reliable, eco-conscious way to support desert plants in both traditional pots and mineral-based setups.

With Sybotanica, Cacti Slow-Release Plant Food makes low-maintenance care effortless, giving your collection the strength to thrive naturally over time.
